# THIRD INDEX

> Principal-led design engineering studio building custom web apps, product interfaces, design systems, and high-craft websites.

THIRD INDEX is based in Las Vegas, led by Michael Ciccarelli, and works with brands, creative agencies, founders, and product teams worldwide. The studio combines interface design judgment with production engineering so design intent survives implementation.

Core capabilities include product interfaces, design systems, creative frontend development, custom websites, web applications, frontend architecture, motion, WebGL, editorial platforms, and headless commerce.

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://thirdindex.co/): Single landing page covering the studio overview, selected work, capabilities, technology stack, clients, ways to work together, and contact entry points.
- [Selected work](https://thirdindex.co/#work): Representative product, platform, website, commerce, and editorial projects.
- [Studio and capabilities](https://thirdindex.co/#studio): Who runs the studio, focus areas, clients, and stack.

## Ways to work together

Engagements are listed cheapest first. The build is priced by the week, so a single week is a low-risk way to start and the same engagement extends when the work warrants it.

- [Frontend build](https://thirdindex.co/sprint): Senior frontend development by the week, from $5k/week over one to three weeks. A finished design turned into responsive, production-ready code — one week for a single surface, three for a full sprint.
- [Prototype](https://thirdindex.co/prototype): $6–10k over one to two weeks, turning a loose idea into a clickable, deployed prototype — real interface, core flows, and a shareable URL.
- [Design-system foundation](https://thirdindex.co/systems): From $10k over two weeks, turning existing designs into a coded, documented component system — tokens, reusable components, and a Storybook-style playground. No original design work; the design stays with the client's team.
- [Fractional design engineering](https://thirdindex.co/fractional): From $10k/month for two days a week, embedded with a product team, three-month minimum. Three days a week from $14k/month.

## Capabilities

- Product interface development and application UI
- Design systems, tokens, components, and documentation
- Custom websites, campaigns, and web applications
- Website rebuilds and redesigns, including information architecture, navigation, and technical SEO
- CMS systemization: content modeling, editing experience, and page-building components
- Creative frontend development, motion, canvas, and WebGL
- Frontend architecture, performance, accessibility, and migrations
- Headless commerce and editorial platforms

## Technology

Primary tools include TypeScript, React, Next.js, Tailwind CSS, GSAP, Motion, Three.js, WebGL, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Supabase, Shopify, Sanity, Stripe, and Figma. The stack is selected to fit each engagement.

## Representative clients and work

Representative names include Modern Treasury, VICE, Amazon, Condé Nast, Pentagram, Legend, One/Of, Elara, Revolve Law, Kelvon Agee, The Well, and El Dorado.

## Fit

THIRD INDEX is first and foremost senior frontend development for teams with ambitious designs and nobody available to build them properly, supported by full-stack capability, product judgment, motion, systems thinking, and enough design ability to close gaps without supervision. It is a strong fit for teams shipping ambitious web products and brand surfaces where interface craft, accessibility, maintainability, and senior technical judgment matter — and for design studios and designers who need a technical partner to execute and systematize their designs. Engagements may be project-based or fractional.

The studio is not focused on pure backend infrastructure, visual design without implementation, or native iOS and Android development.
